items.stem: What should come first when choosing an AI tool for work?

options.text: A clear statement of the problem and desired outcome
options.rationale: Correct: define the problem before shopping for tools.
Advertising is not a selection basis.
Price alone is not the first criterion.

items.stem: Which TWO belong in a data and security check for an AI tool? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Where the tool stores and processes your data
options.rationale: Correct: data location is a key concern.

options.text: Whether vendor terms allow reuse of your data for training
options.rationale: Correct: reuse terms matter for privacy.

options.text: The colour of the tool's logo
How many awards the vendor advertises
options.rationale: Awards do not establish data safety.

items.explanation: Correct: data location is a key concern.

items.stem: Why pilot an AI tool before a full rollout?

options.text: To test real fit and surface problems at low risk
options.rationale: Correct: a pilot limits risk and reveals issues.

options.text: To guarantee the tool will be free
options.rationale: A pilot does not change pricing.
A pilot is part of evaluation, not a skip.

options.text: To avoid ever making a decision
options.rationale: A pilot informs the decision, not avoids it.

items.explanation: Correct: a pilot limits risk and reveals issues.
